Welcome to mee veterinary ammaii 🐾

Here you’ll find practical animal care advice, delicious home cooking, and authentic daily vlogs.
What You’ll Find Here:

🐄 Animal Care & Tips: Livestock health precautions, disease prevention, and practical first-aid guides for cows, goats, and farm animals.

🍲 Cooking & Recipes: Quick, simple, and tasty dishes made step-by-step in my free time.

🎥 Daily Life & Vlogs: Behind-the-scenes, personal daily routines, and lifestyle moments.

Join the journey for useful veterinary tips, great food, and fun vlogs!
👉 LIKE, SHARE & SUBSCRIBE to support the channel! 🔔

⚠️ Disclaimer: The information provided in this channel (videos/shorts) is strictly for educational and informational purposes only. It is NOT a substitute for professional veterinary advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a licensed veterinarian for specific health concerns regarding your pets or animals.
